note: USFS Shawnee NF (Wolf Lake), at the foot of the LaRue-Pine Hills bluffs. Level sites with open grass between them; popular with hunters in spring and fall. Pine Hills Road climbs to bluff-top overlooks; the nearby Snake Road closes to vehicles in spring and fall for the reptile migration. --Claude
